name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 15 · bricoler, ruser, s'adjoindre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (man laying bricks for a little wall, fox in a fake moustache sneaking past the hen house, juggler with six balls on the balcony, decorator shelling peanuts at the upper window, man pulling on a pirate costume on the roof terrace), -ir/-re RIGHT (duckling hurrying to join the line of ducks, round mirror on the wall). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.

items.mirror: round mirror on the cottage wall beside the ducks
